raw.query: SELECT d.run_id, d.window_name, d.tp, d.n_replicas, l.p99_ms FROM v_pool_latency l JOIN v_dim d ON l.run_id=d.run_id WHERE d.is_current=true AND l.sla_metric='ttft' AND d.experiment='grid' AND d.window_name IN ('burst1','burst2','burst3','burst4','burst5') AND ((d.n_replicas=4) OR (d.tp=2 AND d.n_replicas=2)) ORDER BY d.window_name, d.n_replicas
raw.claimed: TP1x4 (4 H100s) fails all five burst windows, TP2x2 (4 H100s) passes each, a 1.55-1.74x tail cut from layout alone
raw.evidence: Both layouts are iso-cost at 4 H100s (4x1 = 2x2); DB TTFT p99 shows TP1x4 1313.8-1331.4 ms (>1000 bound, fail) vs TP2x2 763.4-845.7 ms (<1000 bound, pass), ratios 1.55-1.74x, exactly matching tab:base-tp.
